On Wed, Dec 30, 2015 at 9:08 PM, vijay goel <vijay...@gmail.com> wrote:
Update: A solution partially worked.

  x<- list()
  
  output$ui<- renderUI({
    lapply(1:4, function(i) {
      testList<- radioButtons(paste0('r', i), paste0('Next step'),
                              choices = list("Ignore" = 1, "Revisit later" = 2, "Will follow-up" = 3), 
                              selected = 2)
    a<- do.call(tagList, testList)
    b<- tags$img(src=imgs[idxTab()])
    x<- list(x,a,b)
    })
  })

This displays output in needed format, but adds a repeated tag in interface that needs cleaning: "div r4 form-group shiny-input-radiogroup shiny-input-container"

On Wednesday, December 30, 2015 at 5:22:24 PM UTC-8, vijay goel wrote:
Hi,

Trying to display an output of Image-radiobutton-Image-radiobutton-Image-radiobutton-Image-radiobutton... reactively based on an input (tab1). I'm able to get individual loops working e.g. Image-Image-Image-Image- and radiobutton-radiobutton-radiobutton-, (in output$test and output$radio), but not able to put them one after the other.

Any ideas? Pasting relevant parts of code below.

Thanks,
Vijay


shinyServer(function(input, output, session)
{
  # ask for parameters: table - give a dropdown in UI
  output$tabOptions <-
    renderUI({
      testList <- lapply(1:1, function(i) {
        selectInput(paste0("tab",i), "Choose table:", as.list(tableNames), selected = tableNames[1])
      })
      do.call(tagList, testList)
    })
  
  #table index to refer to correct list
  idxTab <- reactive(match(input$tab1,tableNames))
  
  output$test <-
    renderUI({
      lapply(1:1, function(i) {
        tags$img(src=imgs[i,idxTab()])})   #imgs data frame has image path
      })

  output$radio <- renderUI({
    testList<- lapply(1:idxTab(), function(i)
      radioButtons(paste0('r', i), paste0('Next step'),
                        choices = list("Ignore" = 1, "Revisit later" = 2, "Will follow-up" = 3), 
                        selected = 2))
    do.call(tagList, testList)
    })
 
}


shinyUI(
  fluidPage(
    title = 'Creating UI from a loop',
    mainPanel(uiOutput("tabOptions")),
    mainPanel(uiOutput("test")),
    mainPanel(uiOutput("radio"))
  )
)
